verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs cover the CUDA toolkit and libraries, the NeMo framework for multi-GPU training, and JAX Toolbox's public CI and Docker images for JAX on NVIDIA GPUs. The DGX B200 software stack includes the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. None of these sources explicitly name B200, PyTorch, or a framework support matrix, so mainstream-framework support on this GPU is only implied. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch build/support documentation, a framework/CUDA support matrix naming B200, B200-specific framework compatibility evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of frameworks running on B200.
